name: tomevault
description: The perfect addition to your TTRPG sessions, TomeVault is a multiplayer companion app for handouts, inventory management, and ambience control. It enhances gameplay by providing a centralized platform for players and game masters to share resources, manage character inventories, and create immersive atmospheres with ease.
learningNotes: JSON files do not allow real comments, so this field explains purpose: package.json is metadata used by Node tooling. In this project it mainly sets module type to ESM so index.mjs can use import/export syntax directly in modern browsers and tooling.
